scope_statement: Cross-community research landscape for principal-provenance authority control and secure LLM agents.
inclusion_criteria: directly constrains or evaluates agent effects, authority, provenance, information flow, memory, or policy
provides a foundational formalism or production substrate needed by Conflux
contains a benchmark or attack family that tests stated Conflux assumptions
is primary/official where available; secondary surveys used for coverage triangulation
exclusion_or_deprioritization: generic AI safety without tool/action relevance
pure factuality/provenance work unless it supplies reusable trace/evidence mechanisms
secondary summaries when a primary paper/specification is available

evidence_tiers.E: lead only; not used to support claims

name_disambiguation.FORGE/PCAS: same arXiv lineage; title/version changed from Policy Compiler for Secure Agentic Systems to Formal Policy Enforcement for Real-World Agentic Systems
name_disambiguation.ProvenanceGuard: action-alignment paper is distinct from source-aware factuality work using the same name
name_disambiguation.AgentSentry: execution-provenance Agent-Sentry is distinct from temporal-causal diagnostics AgentSentry
name_disambiguation.PACT: here means Provenance-Aware Capability Contracts / argument-level provenance, not unrelated PACT acronyms

limitations: Very recent 2026 preprints may change title, author list, or claims.
Canonical identifiers and titles for very recent preprints should be revalidated before bibliography freeze.
Reported benchmark numbers are author-reported unless a backlog task explicitly reproduces them.
The public repository was not cloned and rerun as part of this literature-only update.
Coverage is broad but cannot guarantee inclusion of unpublished/proprietary work.
